description: Same public-record answer as ziplot_deal_check for a US address, plus a `deal` block: illustrative arithmetic on the inputs you give (monthly payment, monthly cash flow, NOI, cap rate, cash-on-cash, DSCR), with every input, its source (caller, default or deal-check), each assumption and each formula shown. price is required. rent defaults to the HUD Small Area FMR from deal-check and tax to the deal-check property-tax estimate at your price; rate and insurance have no default and their results are null until given. Defaults: 30-year term, 25% down, 3% closing costs, HOA 0, vacancy 8%, management 8% (an assumption; set 0 if you self-manage), maintenance 5%. Informational arithmetic on the inputs shown. Not financial, tax or legal advice. Status values. Top-level status: ok = every evaluated section answered; needs_review = partial answer, at least one section needs a person or a retry (read each section's status and the warnings); unavailable = no section could be answered (address not found, or every source failed); out_of_scope = no evaluated section applies at this address. Section status uses the same words plus not_covered (this area is not evaluated). str.status follows the two permit determinations: new_non_owner_occupied_permit.value (allowed, not_allowed, needs_review, out_of_scope, not_covered, unavailable) and owner_occupied_permit.value (possible, not_allowed, needs_review, out_of_scope, not_covered, unavailable). Both firm = ok, one firm and one not = needs_review, none usable = unavailable. str.supporting_data_status appears when side lookups such as permit counts or building lists were incomplete.

address.description: US street address including city and state, e.g. '321 50th Ave N, Nashville, TN'

bedrooms.description: For the HUD rent benchmark. Defaults to 2.

closing_pct.description: Closing costs, percent of price. Default 3.

down_pct.description: Down payment, percent of price. Default 25.

hoa.description: Monthly HOA dues in USD. Default 0.

insurance.description: Annual insurance premium in USD. No default.

maintenance_pct.description: Maintenance allowance, percent of rent. Default 5.

management_pct.description: Management fee, percent of rent. Default 8 (assumption; 0 if self-managed).

rate.description: Annual mortgage interest rate in percent, e.g. 6.5. No default.

rent.description: Monthly rent in USD. Default: HUD Small Area FMR from deal-check.

tax.description: Annual property tax in USD. Default: deal-check estimate at your price.

vacancy_pct.description: Vacancy allowance, percent of rent. Default 8.
